description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 19.12.2016 - 25.12.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it creates binding rules for customs transactions rather than addressing government personnel, structure, or other specialized categories.
